excluded_tasks.title: Multi-step synthesis route planning
excluded_tasks.reason: Explicit user scope decision: do not develop a competing target-to-stock route-search benchmark or seek to replace PaRoutes.
excluded_tasks.boundary: Excludes multi-step synthetic route search, route ranking/diversity and route-level optimization. Keeps single-step precursor prediction, per-reaction experimental decisions and physical elementary reaction networks.

rights_policy: Local source availability and release eligibility are separate. Verified CC BY-NC data are accepted in separate noncommercial partitions; copyleft and database obligations remain explicit. Historical bindings with unresolved original permissions remain visible without being selected for publication. New promoted bindings require admitted table/source grants; quarantined views are excluded.

input_modalities: reactor geometry, process variables and sensor histories
evaluation: data quality, provenance, licenses and reproducibility
cross_cutting_axes.coverage_rule: Each axis needs an evidence matrix. Listing a domain, modality or evaluation dimension does not establish data or results for it. General molecular-property prediction, unrelated biology and plant/supply-chain optimization are outside the reaction-centred boundary.

initial_delivery_policy: After acquisition, pilot and freeze each task variant, group allocation, model interface and measured resource budget. Source-backed coverage and redistribution clearance do not imply completed predictive benchmarks. The release manifest selects only explicit eligible paths and excludes contradictory or unresolved grants.
delivery_policy: The source-qualified coverage matrix extends the initial22-definition/96-binding preparation scope. Its promoted contracts require task-specific baselines and evaluation before benchmark completion is claimed. Initial budget estimates are historical and do not certify execution of the expanded matrix.
